metric.name: offset shelf support proxy per volume

instruction: FreeCAD quantified CAD optimization task. Open /home/user/Desktop/baseline.stl and /home/user/Desktop/profile.dxf in FreeCAD, use them as the starting geometry and footprint guide, and redesign the part as a lightweight load-bearing fixture. This is a continuous-score optimization task, not a request to match one hidden answer. Case: DIN rail equipment shelf. Objective: Maximize support proxy per volume for a DIN rail equipment shelf carrying an offset load. Required output: /home/user/Desktop/optimized.stl. Hard constraints: keep the STL within envelope [120.0, 50.0, 42.0] mm, keep bounding-box spans at least [112.0, 44.0, 22.0] mm, keep volume between 15000.0 and 90000.0 mm^3, and preserve material in every support/load zone marked in /home/user/Desktop/profile.dxf and /home/user/Desktop/constraints.json. The evaluator parses only the real optimized.stl geometry, computes required-zone coverage and this continuous metric: offset shelf support proxy / volume; x-span and vertical depth matter more than unused width. It writes score.json and quant_metrics.json, and ignores any self-reported score. Do not read or copy ground_truth and do not edit eval.py.
